title_en: Getting Started - Setup Facebook and Instagram Lead Ads
source_md:
Connect your Facebook and Instagram channels to manage lead generation ads. Capture high-quality leads directly from social media. Facebook and Instagram Lead Ads let you capture prospect information from Meta ads and manage campaign setup directly in HighLevel.

---

**TABLE OF CONTENTS**

- [What are Facebook and Instagram Lead Ads?](#What-are-Facebook-and-Instagram-Lead-Ads?)
- [How to Setup Facebook/Instagram Lead Ads](#How-to-Setup-Facebook/Instagram-Lead-Ads)
- [Publishing an Existing Ad](#Publishing-an-Existing-Ad)
- [Frequently Asked Questions](#Frequently-Asked-Questions)
- [Related Articles](#Related-Articles)

---

# **What are Facebook and Instagram Lead Ads?**

Lead generation campaigns can use Facebook lead forms to collect information such as a prospect's name, email address, phone number, or answers to custom questions.

Facebook and Instagram Lead Ads in HighLevel allow you to create and manage Meta lead generation campaigns from **Marketing > Ad Manager**. When form fields are mapped to the appropriate HighLevel contact fields, submitted lead information can be organized in the CRM for follow-up and automation.

---

## **How to Setup Facebook/Instagram Lead Ads**

#### **Step 1:** Open and Activate Ad Manager

Ad Manager must be activated for the sub-account before Meta assets can be connected and campaigns can be created.

1. In the HighLevel sub-account, navigate to **Marketing > Ad Manager**.
2. If Ad Manager has not been activated, click **Activate Ads Manager**

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155078477956/original/os-WfwWeGuPqqUT2BXo-rUJ8jvS9dCIriA.png?1786726217)

#### **Step 2:** Connect Facebook

1. From the Ad Manager onboarding screen, click **Connect Facebook**.
2. Complete the Facebook login or authorization flow and grant the requested permissions to LeadConnector.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155078478030/original/MM6zYytVDK-6souUuz8yukJ0octEcRIt9w.png?1786726295)

#### **Step 3:**Select a Meta Ads Account

1. Locate **Select a Meta ads account** dropdown or search field to find and select the correct ad account.
2. Under the Facebook Page selection area, search for and select the page you want to use. Then click **Connect.**
3. Once the page is connected, click the **Get Started**button.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155078478284/original/FRrZ6nzG6F9CmytUvtYpb6wcwlwouuWGAg.png?1786726486)

#### **Step 4:**Create a Campaign

1. Click **+ Create Campaign**.
2. Select **Meta** as the platform.
3. Click **Next**.
4. Choose to start from scratch or use an available Ad Manager template.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155078478808/original/3wuI73yvsr9iNfV_RCq1XNdF6CI5lHQJuw.gif?1786726707)

#### **Step 5:** Select the Lead Generation Objective

1. Select **Lead Generation** as the campaign objective.
2. If applicable, select the appropriate **Special Ad Category**. If the campaign does not fall within a special category, choose the applicable not-applicable option.
3. Continue to the ad set configuration.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155078479094/original/3wwOmLf_wZPrUlmes-oYFUwyn1tjkr55zw.png?1786726987)

#### **Step 6:** Configure the Ad Set

Configure the available ad set settings, including:

- Enter an **Ad Set Name**.
- Select the **Facebook Page**.
- Select an **Instagram Account**, when applicable.
- Choose your **Placements**.
- Set the **Budget** and applicable schedule.
- Configure the **Audience** and location settings.

Meta ad spend is charged through the payment method connected to the selected Meta ads account.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155078479251/original/SrlKEzkLNLZ_sCxblXNHYT23Na0IRzuY8w.png?1786727074)

#### **Step 7:**Create or Select a Facebook Lead Form

1. At the ad level, select **Facebook Lead Form** when prompted for the lead destination or supported lead capture option.
2. Open the lead form dropdown.
3. Select an existing form or click **Create Facebook Form**.

If selecting an existing form, review its mapping before continuing. When HighLevel indicates that form fields are not mapped, use the mapping prompt to connect the form fields to the appropriate CRM fields.

If creating a new form, select **+ Create Facebook form**then complete all required information to create the form.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155078479387/original/2kCd5pWR_5wg2oRt7JOxaH0qLXkm58lOwA.png?1786727209)

#### **Step 8:** Configure the Ad Creative

1. Enter an **Ad Name**.
2. Add the **Primary Text**.
3. Add a **Headline**.
4. Add a description when appropriate.
5. Select the desired **Call to Action**.
6. Upload the applicable image, carousel, or video media.

When the campaign is ready, click **Review**,confirm the campaign details then click **Publish Campaign Now**.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155078479525/original/NfQp9H276rjUdLDUsCsxeSPWwtc8ork92A.png?1786727335)

---

## **Publishing an Existing Ad**

Editing and publishing an existing ad is useful when an ad already exists in HighLevel Ad Manager but still needs to be reviewed or published. This workflow allows you to return to the existing campaign configuration rather than creating a new campaign from the beginning.

1. Navigate to **Marketing > Ad Manager**.
2. Locate the applicable ad or campaign.
3. Click the **three-dot action menu**.
4. Click **Edit**.
5. Review the available campaign, ad set, and ad settings.
6. Continue to the final review and publishing stage.
7. Click the applicable **Publish** action and confirm the publication.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155078479670/original/aCM80odNOJxd1NifeJsyn5E-esLMyTPYng.png?1786727535)

---

## **Frequently Asked Questions**

**Q: Do I need a Meta ads account to use HighLevel Ad Manager for Facebook and Instagram ads?**  
Yes. A Meta ads account must be selected during Ad Manager setup before the onboarding flow can be completed.

**Q: Why is the Get started button disabled?**  
The button remains unavailable until the required Ad Manager connection steps are complete. Confirm a Meta ads account has been selected and a Facebook Page shows as connected.

**Q: Why is field mapping important?**  
Field mapping connects Facebook form responses with the corresponding HighLevel CRM fields. Proper mapping helps ensure details such as name, email, phone number, and custom responses are stored in the correct contact fields.

**Q: Can I use an Instagram account with the campaign?**  
Yes, an Instagram account can be selected at the ad set level when available. If an Instagram account is not connected, campaign behavior can depend on the available Meta configuration and selected placements.

**Q: Can Facebook Lead Ad submissions trigger HighLevel workflows?**  
Yes. When the Facebook integration and lead syncing are configured, Facebook Lead Ad submissions can be used with HighLevel automation, including the Facebook Lead Form Submitted workflow trigger.

---

## **Related Articles**

- [How to Get Started with Meta Campaigns in Ad Manager](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000003044-how-to-get-started-with-meta-campaigns-in-ad-manager)

- [Step-by-Step Guide to Facebook Integration in HighLevel](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/48001157632-step-by-step-guide-to-facebook-integration-in-highlevel)
- [Facebook Multi Page Lead Ads Integration](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000004537-facebook-multi-page-lead-ads-integration)

title_en: View & Edit AI Response Info in Conversations
source_md:
[동영상](https://www.youtube.com/embed/6EfmVcdRo7E?&wmode=opaque)

This article provides a comprehensive guide about how to view the components of AI-generated responses and edit knowledge base entries directly from the conversation view. This functionality increases transparency, enables real-time updates, and enhances the accuracy of AI responses by giving users greater control.

---

**TABLE OF CONTENTS**

- [AI Response Info in Conversations](#AI-Response-Info-in-Conversations)
- [Benefits of AI Response Info in Conversations](#Benefits-of-AI-Response-Info-in-Conversations)
- [What AI Response Info is Available?](#What-AI-Response-Info-is-Available?)
- [View & Edit AI Response Info in Conversations](#View-&-Edit-AI-Response-Info-in-Conversations)
- [Frequently Asked Questions](#Frequently-Asked-Questions)

---

# **AI Response Info in Conversations**

AI Response information allows users to:

1. View the AI's underlying components, such as prompts, intents, actions, and data sources.
2. Directly edit knowledge base entries (e.g., FAQs or website data) from within the conversation view.
3. Reflect updates instantly in the AI responses.

This feature is accessible for all AI messages, AI workflow actions, and bot trial messages in your conversations.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155036525714/original/L2Z_DFr3PaA7uZ-jTg6IDH5I2x10b1CV6A.png?1731538745)

---

# **Benefits of AI Response Info in Conversations**

This feature offers several key benefits:

- **Transparency**: See how the AI generates its responses, including the prompts, intents, and data sources used.
- **Control**: Modify FAQs and website information directly to ensure accuracy.
- **Efficiency**: Update data sources in real-time, improving the AI's performance without navigating away from the conversation.

---

# **What AI Response Info is Available?**

1. **Response:**The actual response from the AI to the contact. This response can be edited so the AI bot knows what to respond like in the future, but editing the response will **NOT** change the response that was already sent to the contact in the conversation.
2. **Prompt**: The instructions the AI followed. This prompt can be edited directly in the AI Response Info sidebar.
3. **Intent**: The goal or purpose of the response. This cannot be changed in the sidebar. Navigate to the Conversation AI settings to adjust the intent.
4. **Sources (Knowledge Chunks & FAQs)**: The sources of the AI bot's response will be found in either a URL used to train the bot or an FAQ from the bot's knowledge base entries.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155036525633/original/_JySdXZQtVTxSa1AxM6AvJDqdWa3W2Mz6w.png?1731538498)

---

# **View & Edit AI Response Info in Conversations**

### **Step 1:**Navigate to the Conversation View

Open a conversation where AI-generated messages are present.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155036525664/original/Q_pbFpqUqVLPrdAgH3Y2o_z8GAYLbBrUwQ.png?1731538598)

### **Step 2:**Identify the AI Message

Locate the message generated by the AI. An AI icon will appear below it.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155036525661/original/8bqSW7gGfzHALbJtt8cRVbwiPOqsgNr67Q.png?1731538587)

### **Step 3:**Open AI Response Info Sidebar

Click on the AI icon to open the AI Response sidebar.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155036525656/original/tLyUD19Q7oawCAXDheV4nmAs9gQQeT8irw.gif?1731538573)

---

# **Frequently Asked Questions**

**Q: Will editing the prompts or sources in the conversation view affect all AI responses?**  
Yes, any changes made to the knowledge base (e.g., FAQs or website data) will be updated immediately and impact all future AI responses that utilize this data.

**Q: How will I know if AI information has been edited?**  
Edited entries will be tagged with an **"Edited"** label in the sidebar.

**Q: Can I undo changes made to the knowledge base?**  
You cannot "undo", but you can re-edit the information to revert it to it's previous state.

[[동영상](https://www.youtube.com/embed/1NPtdNqkRtc?&wmode=opaque)](https://youtu.be/1NPtdNqkRtc)

**In This Article**

- [Overview](#Overview)
- [How to Restore a Deleted Calendar?](#How-to-Restore-a-Deleted-Calendar?)
- [Important Points to Note](#Important-Points-to-Note)

---

### **Overview**

Users can now utilize the "Restore Calendar" feature to recover deleted calendars along with their appointments. This functionality fills a crucial gap, allowing users to undo their actions with ease.

Whenever you delete a calendar, all its appointments are also deleted. Many times users delete their calendars and then want to recover the deleted calendar. With the restore functionality, you can now restore your calendar as well as any appointments that were deleted with the calendar.

---

### **How to Restore a Deleted Calendar?**

- Navigate to Settings > Audit Logs.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155033168218/original/8VenB-Hi6kOYkM1wqsxJgbnfhs_us-EjVA.png?1726746248)

- Identify the log entry corresponding to the deleted calendar.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155033168584/original/KWHKUSke_gJuBh8XSmPvQDOfDHLo7gfFCw.png?1726746471)

- Click on the three dots next to the log entry and select "Restore."

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155033168878/original/MwroShuUDDYtxjRUgG441XBRLf3DrXn6lw.png?1726746628)

- Your calendar, along with all its previously deleted appointments, will be successfully restored.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155033169553/original/BDxNpjemC-gSHk3X5T801yEpqkjvpAg-YQ.png?1726746839)

---

### **Important Points to Note**

- If you've deleted a calendar, all appointments associated with it are also deleted.
- Appointments deleted within ±30 minutes of the calendar deletion time will be restored.
- Any appointments deleted outside of this timeframe will not be recovered.
- Audit logs are retained for a maximum of 60 days. Ensure timely restoration of deleted calendars to avoid data loss.
- **For example,** if you delete a calendar on May 15th at 10:00 AM, all appointments of that calendar will be immediately deleted as well. These appointments are essentially deleted within a timeframe of 30 minutes from the calendar deletion time. When you restore your calendar, all such deleted appointments will be restored. However, if you had deleted an appointment on May 15th at 9:00 AM, that appointment won't be restored.
- This is essentially done to ensure that only those appointments that were deleted as a result of the calendar deletion are restored, and not those appointments that were deleted by the user at another point in time.

## SSO: Easy WP Admin Access

The “WP Admin” button makes it super easy to log into your WordPress admin panel with just one click from your WordPress dashboard. Thanks to Single Sign-On (SSO), you don’t need to type in usernames or passwords — it’s fast and secure!

## Key Features

**•    One-Click Login:** Open the WP Admin panel instantly by clicking a button from the WordPress dashboard.

    **•    Single Sign-On (SSO):** SSO lets you log in securely without showing your password.

    **•    Seamless Integration:** This feature works smoothly with WordPress and doesn’t need any extra plugins.

## Why This Helps You

This feature makes it easy to manage WordPress sites, especially if you work with many different websites.

**•    Easy for Agencies:**If you’re an agency handling multiple clients’ websites, you can quickly open each WP Admin without remembering lots of passwords.

**•    Helpful for Site Owners:**If you manage your own site, just one click takes you to WP Admin without needing to log in.

## How It Works

**1.    Go to Dashboard:**  
Log into HighLevel and open the WordPress dashboard.  
![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155036344521/original/ElAzZg_lJq6zOxBf3_9nSBAlXhNcF2u3VA.png?1731329783)

**2.    Find the Button:**  
You’ll see a “WP Admin” button next to each site.  
![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155036344537/original/eH98xg4l8ybOKn_6W_mU1nmIkBXZTtAqFg.png?1731329799)

**3.    Click to Log In:**  
Press the button, and you’ll go straight to WP Admin.  
![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155036345893/original/HNoDROTwXv9oyHABA8LCsLgzLGaxNVHXTg.png?1731330733)

Now you can easily manage your WordPress site from the admin panel with a simple, secure click! Single Sign On keeps your login safe, without needing a password.

title_en: Workflows Landing Page: New Onboarding Experience
source_md:
**New users of Workflows** can now enjoy a simplified, tailored onboarding experience on the Workflow Automations landing page. The page has been redesigned with AI-powered workflow creation, visual guidance and curated content based on the business niche you select during onboarding. This means from day one, you'll see examples and suggestions relevant to your industry, making it easier to understand how automations work and to set up your first workflow quickly.

The landing page now provides multiple paths to get started: use the AI Builder to describe your automation in plain language, browse pre-built templates for inspiration, or click "Create Workflow" to start from scratch.

```
IMPORTANT: Workflow AI Builder is enabled by default for all agencies via Labs. If you don’t see AI Builder, it may be turned off at the agency or location level.
```

---

**TABLE OF CONTENTS**

- [Workflow AI Builder](#Workflow-AI-Builder)
- [Tailored Onboarding by Business Niche](#Tailored-Onboarding-by-Business-Niche)
- [New Layout with On-Page Videos](#New-Layout-with-On-Page-Videos)
- [Drag and Drop Triggers and Actions onto the Canvas](#Drag-and-Drop-Triggers-and-Actions-onto-the-Canvas)
  - [Labs Enablement & Automatic Rollout](#Labs-Enablement-&-Automatic-Rollout)
  - [Owner Pop-Up in Sub-Accounts](#Owner-Pop-Up-in-Sub-Accounts)
- [Dropdown options under create workflow](#Dropdown-options-under-create-workflow)
- [Frequently Asked Questions](#Frequently-Asked-Questions)

---

## **Workflow AI Builder**

The Workflow AI Builder is now prominently featured on the workflows landing page, making it easier than ever for new users to create their first workflow. Simply describe what you want to automate in plain English, and let AI generate your workflow.

Look for the "What do you want to automate?" prompt at the top of the page. You can type a description like "When form is submitted, send SMS to lead, wait 5 minutes for response - if no response create call task, if they respond add tag" and the AI will build the workflow for you.

Quick-start suggestions like "Lead Nurturing," "Form Automation," and "Email Campaigns" are available below the AI input to help you get started even faster.

## 

---

## **Tailored Onboarding by Business Niche**

When you first start with Workflows, you'll be asked to choose your business niche (industry). The platform then customizes your experience based on that choice. Everything from the examples to the suggested templates will align with your niche.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155060472773/original/4tockivB27MYSUG3Bno4xKEOTfKHXpsLFA.png?1765530961)

- We’ve added ready-made workflow templates for popular niches like **Education**, **Health**, **Finance**, and **Real Estate**. These templates cover common automation scenarios in each industry. For example, a Real Estate agent might see a pre-built template for following up with new property inquiries, while a Health clinic might get a template for appointment reminders. You can use these niche-specific templates as a starting point and customize them to fit your needs, instead of building from scratch.
- A new **"View All Templates**" link lets you browse all available templates directly from the landing page—perfect for those who want inspiration or a quick-start foundation

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155060473194/original/E6qoXfLEk9FZ_g5lpbMkDyCKwgHeqxt_6A.png?1765531167)

---

## **New Layout with On-Page Videos**

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155060473573/original/YDnMJApmLEqWYOZM2B4GmpFEF-2XVAvcSA.png?1765531296)

A **Learn About Workflows**section with tutorial videos. You can scroll the landing page to find a template and launch it, or watch a quick intro video without navigating away. In short, everything you need – templates to start with and learning resources – is available at a glance on the landing page, making it much easier to get started.

Videos on

- Introduction to Workflows: [Here](https://storage.googleapis.com/automation-workflows-production/static/workflow-onboarding-videos/introduction-to-workflows.mp4)
- Workflow Templates: [Here](https://storage.googleapis.com/automation-workflows-production/static/workflow-onboarding-videos/workflow-recipes.mp4)
- Building a Workflow from Scratch: [Here](https://storage.googleapis.com/automation-workflows-production/static/workflow-onboarding-videos/building-a-workflow-from-scratch.mp4)
- Workflow Settings, Enrollment History, and Execution Logs: [Here](https://storage.googleapis.com/automation-workflows-production/static/workflow-onboarding-videos/workflow-settings-logs.mp4)

**Quick access from messages**  
You can open the exact workflow execution directly from a conversation message when troubleshooting.

Mini navigation:

- From Conversations: **message details → Workflow → Execution Details** (context loaded).
- From workflow: **Workflows → open workflow → Logs**.

---

## **Drag and Drop Triggers and Actions onto the Canvas**

You can now add workflow steps faster by dragging triggers and actions directly from the sidebar onto the workflow canvas.

**How it works**

- Open the **Triggers** or **Actions** sidebar in your workflow.
- Click and hold a trigger or action, then drag it onto the canvas.
- Hover over a valid drop target (a **+** marker or between existing steps). A highlighted placeholder shows where the step will be inserted.
- Drop the item, configure it, and **save** to add it to your workflow.

**![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155064712764/original/OXfbIYzBFxXo0ngPp2k3FnOXM0JGPQkz7A.gif?1770826719)**

```
IMPORTANT: If you exit the workflow without saving, the dragged trigger/action is not added to the canvas.
```

---

## **AI Builder availability and controls**

Workflow AI Builder is enabled by default for all agencies.

**Disable AI Builder for an agency (and all sub-accounts)**

Go to Settings → Labs and disable Workflow AI Builder.

**Disable AI Builder for a specific location**

Go to Automations → Global Workflow Settings → Workflow AI and toggle off **AI Builder**.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155071093803/original/4gIwSQd6Mf19iYzJgl1X4URN46hpi5_8gQ.png?1778570385)

---

### **Owner Pop-Up in Sub-Accounts**

Agency owners will see a confirmation pop-up when visiting a sub-account that now has AI Builder, including a quick **Disable** option for that location.

---

## **Dropdown options under create workflow**

Options to start from scratch are still preserved and visible under the create workflow dropdown.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155066282177/original/WVbDBRy8wIjfAKgi_Zy_da7nGIw117QnHw.png?1772717154)

---

## **Frequently Asked Questions**

**Q. I'm not seeing the new experience in my sub-account. Why?**  
The AI Builder needs to be enabled in Labs first in order for this experience to be available. Go to Settings > Labs and enable the AI Builder feature to access the new workflows landing page experience.

**Q. I don't want to show this new experience with AI to my users. How do I remove it?**

You can disable AI Builder at either level:

**Agency**: Go to Settings → Labs and disable Workflow AI Builder.

**Location**: Go to Automations → Global Workflow Settings → Workflow AI and toggle off **AI Builder.**

title_en: How to Use BNPL in Order Forms and Payment Links
source_md:
[동영상](https://www.youtube.com/embed/FAKPHy7aYhs?&wmode=opaque)

We are excited to announce that Buy Now Pay Later (BNPL) payment methods are now supported in Order Forms and Payment Links. This is applicable for both 1-step and 2-step order forms. Business users can now offer the following BNPL options to their customers:

- Klarna
- Affirm
- Afterpay/Clearpay

Key Points:

- Availability: This feature is available only for businesses using Stripe as their payment provider.
- Applicable Products: BNPL options are available for one-time products only, not for recurring products.
- Benefits: Offering BNPL methods can help increase conversions by providing payment flexibility to customers.
- Order & Transaction Details: All order and transaction details will be recorded under the Payments menu, similar to credit card payments. Existing triggers for Order Submitted and Payment Received will function as usual
- This change requires migration from Stripe and would be already available for some accounts and progress for others

# 단축 URL이 포함된 문자 메시지의 전송 문제 이해하기

**개요**

단축 URL은 SMS 캠페인에서 링크 추적(문자 메시지 캠페인의 성과 측정에 도움)과 글자 수 절약을 위해 자주 사용됩니다. 하지만 전송률에도 문제를 일으킬 수 있어요. 공개 단축 URL은 종종 여러 번 리다이렉트되고 발신자에 대한 정보를 거의 제공하지 않기 때문에 문자 메시지가 차단될 수 있습니다.

T-Mobile과 AT&T 같은 통신사들은 공개 링크 단축기(예: bit.ly, rb.gy)가 포함된 메시지를 점점 더 차단하거나 필터링하고 있어요. 이런 단축기들이 사기 웹사이트를 숨기고 여러 번 리다이렉트할 수 있기 때문입니다.

해결책: 브랜드와 일치하는 브랜드 도메인이나 커스텀 도메인을 사용하세요. 이렇게 하면 전송률이 개선될 뿐만 아니라 고객과의 신뢰도 쌓을 수 있습니다.

---

## **단축 URL이 문제를 일으키는 이유**

- **여러 번의 리다이렉트**
  
  공개 단축기들은 종종 최종 목적지에 도달하기 전에 사용자를 여러 번 리다이렉트합니다.
  
  통신사는 이를 의심스러운 행동으로 간주해요. 사기 사이트를 숨길 수 있거든요.

- **발신자 투명성 부족**
  
  일반 도메인(예: bit.ly)은 브랜드와의 명확한 연결을 제공하지 않습니다.
  
  이로 인해 통신사가 필터링하거나 차단할 가능성이 높아져요.

- **통신사 정책**
  
  **T-Mobile (2020년 9월 1일부터 행동 규범 시행):**
  - 비즈니스와 연결된 단일하고 인식 가능한 도메인을 선호
  - 브랜드 단축 URL은 허용
  - URL 순환(필터를 우회하기 위한 도메인 교체) 금지
  - 여러 번의 리다이렉트 권장하지 않음
  
  **AT&T:** 사기 및 피싱 위험으로 인해 공개 링크 단축기를 완전히 차단

간단히 요약하면, **T-Mobile**은 2020년 9월 1일부터 상업적 메시징을 위한 행동 규범을 도입했어요. 이 규범은 T-Mobile 네트워크에서 비즈니스 관련 메시징에 대한 지침과 기대치를 제시합니다. T-Mobile에 연결된 기기를 사용하는 사람과 소통하려면, 이 새로운 규칙을 따르는 것이 중요해요.

**T-Mobile**은 단일하고 인식 가능한 도메인 이름 사용을 선호합니다. 행동 규범에 따르면, 메시징 프로그램은 비즈니스의 웹 도메인과 연결되어야 해요. 전체 도메인을 사용하는 것이 선호되지만, 커스텀 링크 제공을 위한 브랜드 단축 URL 사용은 허용됩니다. 이는 소비자와의 일관성 유지, 브랜드 인지도 향상, 링크에 대한 신뢰도 증진에 도움이 돼요.

**T-Mobile**은 URL에 대해 더 많은 규칙을 가지고 있어요. "금지된 메시징 관행" 섹션에서 URL과 관련된 두 가지 규칙이 있습니다:

- 스팸 필터를 우회하기 위한 URL 순환 사용을 금지합니다. 이는 bit.ly나 rb.gy 같은 공개 URL 단축기가 차단될 가능성이 높다는 의미로, 해당 URL이 포함된 메시지가 전송되지 않을 수 있어요.

- T-Mobile은 여러 번 리다이렉트하는 URL 사용을 권장하지 않아요. 이런 URL은 소비자로부터 실제 웹사이트 목적지를 숨겨 잠재적으로 사기 웹사이트로 이어질 수 있습니다. T-Mobile의 스팸 필터는 여러 번 리다이렉트하는 URL을 특별히 확인하며, 이런 URL이 포함된 메시지는 차단될 가능성이 높아요.

실제로 **AT&T**는 사기 활동 및 피싱 스캠과의 연관성으로 인해 공개 링크 단축기를 완전히 차단하기로 결정했어요. T-Mobile과 다른 통신사들이 아직 같은 입장을 취하지는 않았지만, 미래를 대비해 지금부터 메시지 전송률을 개선하는 조치를 취하는 것이 현명할 거예요.

---

## **비즈니스에게 미치는 영향**

- 통신사 정책의 변화는 스팸, 사기, 남용을 줄이려는 업계 전반의 노력을 반영해요.

- 안타깝게도 이는 링크 추적을 복잡하게 만들어요. 링크 추적은 비즈니스가 SMS/MMS 캠페인 성과를 측정하는 주요 방법 중 하나거든요.

- 회사들은 URL 관행을 조정하여 전송 성공과 추적 필요 사이의 균형을 맞춰야 합니다.

---

**링크가 포함된 메시지 전송을 개선하는 3가지 방법**

URL이 포함된 메시지의 전송률을 높이고 실수로 차단되는 것을 방지하기 위해 취할 수 있는 몇 가지 단계는 다음과 같아요:

**1. 링크의 리다이렉트 횟수를 제한하세요.** 링크가 사용자를 다른 랜딩 페이지나 도메인 주소에 도달하기까지 여러 번 거쳐가게 하면, 사용자와 통신사 모두에게 의심을 불러일으켜요. 링크 목적지를 최적화하고 UTM 파라미터 같은 추적 방법을 사용해서 여러 번의 리다이렉트를 피하는 것을 고려해보세요.

**2. 전체 길이 URL 사용**이 통신사의 첫 번째 제안이지만, 160자 제한 내에서 비즈니스 식별과 맥락 정보도 포함해야 하는 SMS에서 소중한 공간을 차지할 수 있어요. 중요한 링크가 있다면 전체 길이 URL을 사용하고 추가 메시지 세그먼트로 인한 추가 비용을 감수하는 것이 최선일 수 있어요.

**3. 공간이 제한적일 때는 도메인과 식별 가능한 브랜드 단축 URL을 사용하는 것을 고려해보세요.** 이 방법은 ESPN, Nike, 뉴욕 타임스 같은 대기업에만 국한되지 않아요. bit.ly나 rb.gy 같은 무료 공개 링크 단축기를 사용하는 것이 비용 효율적으로 보일 수 있지만, 메시지가 전송되지 않는다면 비즈니스에 미치는 비용이 누적될 수 있어요. 단축 URL용 커스텀 도메인에 투자하는 것은 종종 예상보다 저렴해요.

---

## **핵심 요점**

전송된 SMS마다 비용을 지불하는 것이지, 전송된 것만이 아니에요. 브랜드 도메인에 투자하고 위험한 관행(공개 단축기 및 리다이렉트 체인 등)을 줄이면 전송률을 최대화하고, 브랜드를 보호하며, 고객이 실제로 메시지를 받을 수 있도록 도와줘요.
